about_the_game:
“Ground of Aces - Supporter Pack” - Do you like Ground of Aces and want to support its development? The Supporter Pack is just for you! With your contribution, you’re helping shape the future of the game — and we’ve prepared a set of exclusive artifacts from our development backlog to show our gratitude.

  • A set of exclusive events and missions for your game

  • Hand-painted high-resolution artworks from our alpha development

  • A printable set of cards depicting all current planes artworks and abilities

  • High-resolution versions of the awareness posters from the game

  • An exclusive set of wallpapers with our 3D models

This collection of memories might grow in the future. So check in regularly on the state of things. Thank you very much for supporting Ground of Aces!

Please Note: once purchased, the content of the supporter pack will appear in the game's root installation directory. Use Steams “show installation files” function to find it
